title: The Quiet Surgeon
subtitle: Memoir
author: Walusimbi Leon
description: The true-feeling account of a trauma surgeon working the night shift of an underfunded city hospital — the lives saved, the ones lost, and the silence that holds it together.
style: Spare, unsentimental first-person. Clinical precision alternating with raw human observation. No melodrama.
characters: Dr. Leon — the surgeon, weary, precise, compassionate; the ward — a cast of patients and nurses who recur.
setting: A public hospital in a sprawling modern city, present day.
notes: Begin mid-shift with a crashing patient. Show competence under pressure. Let reflection come in the quiet between cases. Ground every scene in real detail.
